messages:
emma_csm: Heads-up: 20m pre-QBR triage for Meridian Labs (QBR Fri 11AM PT). Focus: embeddings-heavy token econ, 90d spend forecast, renewal risk and enablement blockers. Can we do a 4pm PT sync today? cc @joel_fin @rachel_eng

joel_fin: I can do 4pm. Quick billing snapshot: current run-rate ~$9.1k/mo; embeddings ~70% of spend. If usage doubles after their new release, forecast ~$18k/mo. Will prep reserve vs throttle numbers.

rachel_eng: From eng: they recently toggled to 512-d vectors and enabled hourly batch jobs. Also their SDK retries on 5xx without idempotency which may double some calls. I'll paste a small caching + idempotency snippet.

sam_support: Enablement note: customer still hasn't wired prefix caching and uses short TTLs; repeats are causing high vector counts. I can demo a minimal change in the sync.

ops-bot: Billing alert: Meridian Labs embed spike +76% vs baseline yesterday triggered rule embed_spike_high. Alert: https://redwood.ops/alerts/90123

emma_csm: Proposed agenda: 1) baseline + two scenarios (x1.25, x2) 2) immediate levers (batch windowing, KV/prefix cache, idempotency, quotas) 3) owners + pre-read to customer. Good?

joel_fin: Rough forecast (quick):
- current run-rate: $9.1k/mo
- growth x1.25 -> $11.4k/mo
- growth x2 -> $18.2k/mo
Assumes avg 2 vectors/request @512-d. I'll upload per-route CSV before the sync.

rachel_eng: snippets (pseudo):
```
# simple prefix KV cache
if prefix in kv_cache:
  return kv_cache[prefix]
v = embeddings.embed(prefix)
kv_cache[prefix] = v
return v

# idempotency header
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = request_id
```
I'll demo a patch to their SDK to add both.

sam_support: Action: I'll create a one-pager with quick enablement steps and attach code samples.

emma_csm: Locking 4pm PT. Joel please post the reserve vs throttle summary before the call. If you can't make it, drop notes here and tag owners. Inviting Meridian Labs PM now. :white_check_mark:
